tEn: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity
tZh: Seedance 2.0：面向世界复杂性的视频生成新进展
sEn: Seedance 2.0 is a native multimodal audio-video generation model that jointly handles text, image, audio, and video inputs, achieving industry-leading performance across key generation dimensions and supporting direct 4–15 second 480p/720p output.
sZh: Seedance 2.0 是一个原生多模态音视频生成模型，统一支持文本、图像、音频和视频输入，在视频与音频生成的关键维度上达到业界领先水平，并支持直接生成 4–15 秒、480p/720p 的音视频内容。
absEn: Seedance 2.0 is a new native multi-modal audio-video generation model, officially released in China in early February 2026. Compared with its predecessors, Seedance 1.0 and 1.5 Pro, Seedance 2.0 adopts a unified, highly efficient, and large-scale architecture for multi-modal audio-video joint generation. This allows it to support four input modalities: text, image, audio, and video, by integrating one of the most comprehensive suites of multi-modal content reference and editing capabilities available in the industry to date. It delivers substantial, well-rounded improvements across all key sub-dimensions of video and audio generation. In both expert evaluations and public user tests, the model has demonstrated performance on par with the leading levels in the field. Seedance 2.0 supports direct generation of audio-video content with durations ranging from 4 to 15 seconds, with native output resolutions of 480p and 720p. For multi-modal inputs as reference, its current open platform supports up to 3 video clips, 9 images, and 3 audio clips. In addition, we provide Seedance 2.0 Fast version, an accelerated variant of Seedance 2.0 designed to boost generation speed for low-latency scenarios. Seedance 2.0 has delivered significant improvements to its foundational generation capabilities and multi-modal generation performance, bringing an enhanced creative experience for end users.
absZh: Seedance 2.0 是一款新的原生多模态音视频生成模型，于 2026 年 2 月初在中国正式发布。与之前的 Seedance 1.0 和 1.5 Pro 相比，Seedance 2.0 采用了统一、高效且大规模的多模态音视频联合生成架构。这使得它能够支持文本、图像、音频和视频四种输入模态，并集成了迄今为止业界最全面的多模态内容参考与编辑能力之一。它在视频和音频生成的各个关键子维度上都带来了全面而显著的提升。在专家评测和公开用户测试中，该模型均表现出与该领域领先水平相当的性能。Seedance 2.0 支持直接生成时长 4 至 15 秒的音视频内容，原生输出分辨率包括 480p 和 720p。对于作为参考的多模态输入，其当前开放平台最多支持 3 个视频片段、9 张图像和 3 个音频片段。此外，我们还提供了 Seedance 2.0 Fast 版本，这是 Seedance 2.0 的加速变体，旨在提升低延迟场景下的生成速度。Seedance 2.0 在其基础生成能力和多模态生成性能方面均实现了显著改进，为最终用户带来了更出色的创作体验。

paras.en:
Video generation models have become a core technology for modern digital content infrastructure and generative AI ecosystems, with rapid, widespread adoption in both professional content production and consumer-facing creative scenarios. Through years of iterative research and engineering optimization, the ByteDance Seed team has built full-stack generative media technologies—including the previous Seedance video generation series [6, 15, 16, 23], Seedream image generation and editing series [5, 7, 13, 17, 19, 20], Seed-VL multimodal vision-language models for cross-modal semantic understanding [3, 4, 9], and other key components [21, 22]—which are now widely integrated into our large-scale product ecosystem, supporting video generation services for billions of daily active users. In this work, we push the frontier of video generation with a notable paradigm shift: from generating short video clips with limited controllability to robust, highly controllable video synthesis that natively supports diverse control signals. This industry-wide trend has driven the development of Seedance 2.0, a new model designed specifically to deliver enhanced generation quality with rich multi-modal controllability for large-scale creative engine platforms.

Seedance 2.0 is a new native multi-modal audio-video generation model, officially released in China in early February 2026. Compared with its predecessors, Seedance 1.0 and 1.5 Pro [6, 16], Seedance 2.0 adopts a unified, highly efficient, and large-scale architecture for multi-modal audio-video joint generation. It supports four input modalities—text, image, audio, and video—by integrating one of the most comprehensive suites of multi-modal content reference and editing capabilities available in the industry to date. It delivers substantial, well-rounded improvements across all key sub-dimensions of video and audio generation. In both expert evaluations and public user tests, the model has demonstrated performance on par with the leading levels in the field.

Within its multi-modal framework, Seedance 2.0 is equipped with a full set of multi-modal reference and editing capabilities, supporting both standalone and combinatorial tasks, including subject control, motion manipulation, style transfer, special effects design and creative content generation, as well as video extension. This suite of capabilities makes the model applicable to a diverse array of creative production scenarios. The model achieves more accurate compliance with complex instructions and more stable motion performance, enabling it to accommodate more sophisticated production workflows. Coupled with its native, professional multi-shot narrative capability, vivid details of motion and facial expressions, and improved cross-frame consistency, the model reaches a competitive usability rate in real-world production settings.

Seedance 2.0 supports direct generation of audio-video content with durations ranging from 4 to 15 seconds, with native output resolutions of 480p and 720p. For multi-modal reference inputs, its current open platform supports up to 3 video clips, 9 images, and 3 audio clips. In addition, we provide Seedance 2.0 Fast, an accelerated variant designed to boost generation speed for low-latency scenarios. Seedance 2.0 has delivered significant improvements to its foundational generation capabilities and multi-modal generation performance, bringing an enhanced creative experience for end users. Its key model capabilities are highlighted as follows.

- **Generation of Real-World Complexity.** Seedance 2.0 achieves remarkable improvements in generation quality, particularly in human motion modeling, which delivers significantly enhanced naturalness, temporal coherence, and physical plausibility compared with previous versions. It can synthesize temporally precise, complex interaction scenes with high fidelity, while adhering to real-world motion laws throughout the generation process, thereby mitigating the artifacts common in recent video generation models. For detailed close-up shots, the generated frames exhibit highly realistic details and rigorous consistency—whether for subtle changes in light refraction or natural, fluid interactions between characters and the environment—closely matching the visual fidelity of real-world live-action footage. With robust motion stability and physics compliance, the model delivers favorable performance in multi-subject interaction and complex motion scenarios, achieving a usability rate that is clearly higher than recent commercial models.

- **Strong Multimodal Capability.** First, Seedance 2.0 accepts comprehensive multimodal reference inputs, allowing users to combine text, image, video, and audio sources. The model can accurately interpret multimodal input content and generate outputs that reference user-specified elements—including frame composition, cinematographic design, motion rhythm, and acoustic characteristics—in accordance with user instructions. It can also directly reference text-based storyboards, enhancing the flexibility of conventional video generation workflows and expanding creative freedom. Second, Seedance 2.0 features substantially improved controllability in video generation. It delivers strong instruction-following performance, accurately generating specified content, and maintaining consistent subject identity preservation even when processing complex scripts with extensive character interactions and fine-grained action descriptions. Meanwhile, the model exhibits fundamental directorial and cinematographic reasoning capabilities, enabling it to autonomously plan shot sequencing and design visual presentation templates. In addition, Seedance 2.0 introduces new video editing capabilities that enable targeted modifications to specified clips, characters, actions, or plot elements. It also provides video continuation functionality, which generates consecutive shots aligned with user prompts, supporting both de novo video generation and seamless extension of existing footage.

- **High-Fidelity Audio-Video Generation.** Seedance 2.0 has binaural audio capability with synchronized, high-fidelity immersive sound generation. It is equipped with an upgraded audio generation module integrated with binaural audio technology, enabling high-fidelity, immersive sound generation. The model supports simultaneous multi-track output of audio content, including background audio, ambient sound effects, and character narration, with precise temporal alignment to the visual rhythm of generated footage. The audio content generated by the model features highly natural sound design, faithfully reproducing subtle natural ambient sounds to enhance scene immersion. Coupled with strict audio-visual temporal control, the model ensures tight synchronization between audio tracks and visual actions, providing robust support for professional-grade audio-visual content creation.

- **Applications in Productivity Scenarios.** Seedance 2.0 exhibits strong cross-scene adaptability, reducing the barriers to professional content production. In response to the diverse demands of video content production, it delivers high-quality generation results across a wide range of use cases, including commercial advertising, cinematic and television visual effects, game animation, and commentary videos. By replacing complex visual effects production and live-action shooting workflows with AI generation, Seedance 2.0 can significantly reduce production costs and shorten the production cycle of professional audio-video content, helping creators and enterprises realize their creative concepts.

From the audio-video synchronous generation achieved by Seedance 1.5 [16] to the unified multimodal audio-video joint generation framework established by Seedance 2.0, the Seedance series has consistently been built around a unified architecture, with a core commitment to high-fidelity reconstruction of real-world complexity. We acknowledge that Seedance 2.0 remains imperfect, with room for improvement in its generation outputs. Moving forward, we will continue to explore deep alignment between generative models and the physical world, advance accurate modeling of real-world dynamics, deepen our understanding of physical and semantic rules, and enable the technology to better serve every creator. Safety is a core consideration in our work. Throughout the model iteration lifecycle, we have implemented a structured safety assessment framework and made continuous efforts to evaluate and mitigate potential risks, with the aim of supporting responsible, compliant, and ethically aligned development.
paras.zh:
视频生成模型已成为现代数字内容基础设施和生成式 AI 生态系统的核心技术，在专业内容生产和面向消费者的创意场景中得到了快速而广泛的应用。经过多年的迭代研究和工程优化，字节跳动 Seed 团队构建了全栈式生成媒体技术，包括此前的 Seedance 视频生成系列 [6, 15, 16, 23]、Seedream 图像生成与编辑系列 [5, 7, 13, 17, 19, 20]、用于跨模态语义理解的 Seed-VL 多模态视觉语言模型 [3, 4, 9]，以及其他关键组件 [21, 22]。这些技术现已广泛集成到我们的大规模产品生态中，为数十亿日活跃用户提供视频生成服务。在本工作中，我们通过一次显著的范式转变推动了视频生成技术的前沿：从可控性有限的短视频片段生成，转向原生支持多种控制信号的鲁棒、高可控视频合成。这一行业趋势推动了 Seedance 2.0 的开发；作为新模型，它专为大规模创意引擎平台提供更高的生成质量和丰富的多模态可控性。

Seedance 2.0 是一款新的原生多模态音频-视频生成模型，于 2026 年 2 月上旬在中国正式发布。与之前的 Seedance 1.0 和 1.5 Pro [6, 16] 相比，Seedance 2.0 采用了统一、高效、大规模的多模态音视频联合生成架构。通过集成目前业界最全面的多模态内容参考与编辑能力，它支持文本、图像、音频和视频四种输入模态。该模型在视频和音频生成的所有关键子维度上都实现了大幅且全面的提升。在专家评测和公开用户测试中，该模型均展现出与领域领先水平相当的性能。

在其多模态框架内，Seedance 2.0 配备了完整的多模态参考与编辑能力，支持独立和组合任务，包括主体控制、运动操纵、风格迁移、特效设计与创意内容生成，以及视频扩展。这套能力使该模型适用于多种创意生产场景。模型能更准确地遵循复杂指令，并具有更稳定的运动表现，从而适应更复杂的生产工作流。再加上原生的专业多镜头叙事能力、生动的运动与面部表情细节，以及改进的跨帧一致性，该模型在真实生产环境中达到了具有竞争力的可用率。

Seedance 2.0 支持直接生成时长为 4 至 15 秒的音视频内容，原生输出分辨率包括 480p 和 720p。对于多模态参考输入，其当前开放平台支持最多 3 段视频、9 张图像和 3 段音频。此外，我们提供 Seedance 2.0 Fast 版本，这是 Seedance 2.0 的加速变体，用于提升低延迟场景下的生成速度。Seedance 2.0 在基础生成能力和多模态生成性能上均实现了显著提升，为终端用户带来了更佳的创意体验。其关键模型能力如下。

- **真实世界复杂性的生成。** Seedance 2.0 在生成质量上实现了显著提升，尤其是在人体运动建模方面，与之前的版本相比，自然度、时间一致性和物理合理性都有明显增强。它能够高保真地合成时间精确的复杂交互场景，并在整个生成过程中遵循真实世界的运动规律，从而减轻近期视频生成模型中常见的伪影。在细节特写镜头中，生成的帧展现出高度逼真的细节和严谨的一致性——无论是光折射的微妙变化，还是角色与环境之间自然流畅的交互——都接近真实实拍画面的视觉保真度。凭借稳健的运动稳定性和物理合规性，该模型在多主体交互和复杂运动场景中表现出色，可用率明显高于近期商业模型。

- **强大的多模态能力。** 首先，Seedance 2.0 接受全面的多模态参考输入，允许用户组合文本、图像、视频和音频来源。模型能够准确理解多模态输入内容，并根据用户指令生成参考用户指定元素（包括画面构图、电影化设计、运动节奏和声学特征）的输出。它还可以直接参考基于文本的故事板，从而增强传统视频生成工作流的灵活性，扩展创作自由度。其次，Seedance 2.0 在视频生成的可控性方面有了大幅提升。它具有强大的指令跟随性能，能准确生成指定内容，即使在处理包含大量角色交互和细粒度动作描述的复杂脚本时，也能保持主体身份一致性。同时，该模型展现出基本的导演和电影摄影推理能力，能够自主规划镜头顺序并设计视觉呈现模板。此外，Seedance 2.0 引入了新的视频编辑能力，可对指定的片段、角色、动作或情节元素进行定向修改。它还提供视频续写功能，能够根据用户提示生成连续镜头，既支持从零开始生成视频，也支持对现有素材的无缝扩展。

- **高保真音视频生成。** Seedance 2.0 具备双耳音频能力，可同步生成高保真沉浸式声音。它配备了集成双耳音频技术的升级音频生成模块，能够实现高保真、沉浸式的声音生成。该模型支持同时输出多条音轨内容，包括背景音乐、环境音效和角色旁白，并与生成画面的视觉节奏精确对齐。模型生成的音频内容具有高度自然的声音设计，能忠实再现细微的自然环境声，增强场景沉浸感。再加上严格的音视频时间控制，该模型确保音轨与视觉动作紧密同步，为专业级音视频内容创作提供有力支持。

- **生产力场景应用。** Seedance 2.0 展现出强大的跨场景适应能力，降低了专业内容生产的门槛。针对视频内容生产的多样化需求，Seedance 2.0 在商业广告、影视特效、游戏动画和解说视频等广泛用例中均能提供高质量的生成结果。通过用 AI 生成替代复杂的视觉特效制作和实拍工作流，Seedance 2.0 能显著降低制作成本、缩短专业音视频内容的生产周期，帮助创作者和企业实现创意构思。

从 Seedance 1.5 [16] 实现的音视频同步生成，到 Seedance 2.0 建立的统一多模态音视频联合生成框架，Seedance 系列始终围绕统一架构构建，其核心承诺是对真实世界复杂性的高保真重建。我们承认 Seedance 2.0 并非完美，在生成输出上仍有改进空间。未来，我们将继续探索生成模型与物理世界之间的深度对齐，推动真实世界动力学的精准建模，加深对物理与语义规则的理解，让技术更好地服务每一位创作者。安全是我们工作的核心考量。在模型迭代的全生命周期中，我们实施了结构化的安全评估框架，并持续努力评估和降低潜在风险，以支持负责任、合规且符合伦理的发展。

To objectively and comprehensively assess the overall capabilities of Seedance 2.0 in multi-modal scenarios, our team collaborated with experts from the media industry to establish a comprehensive evaluation benchmark and corresponding evaluation protocols. The benchmark covers audio-video generation, reference-based generation, and video editing scenarios. The evaluation focuses on the model's performance across core dimensions: multi-modal reference-based generation, complex audio-video instruction following, complex motion stability, professional cinematographic language expression, audio and video expressiveness, and audio-visual integrated alignment. As shown in Figure 1, Seedance 2.0 achieves the highest scores across all evaluated dimensions in Text-to-Video (T2V), Image-to-Video (I2V), and Reference-to-Video (R2V) tasks, demonstrating comprehensive leading performance over current competing models.

为了客观、全面地评估 Seedance 2.0 在多模态场景中的整体能力，我们团队与媒体行业专家合作，建立了全面的评测基准和相应的评测协议。该基准涵盖音视频生成、基于参考的生成和视频编辑场景。评测聚焦于模型在以下核心维度的表现：多模态参考生成、复杂音视频指令跟随、复杂运动稳定性、专业影视语言表达、音视频表现力以及音视频整体对齐。如图 1 所示，在文本生成视频（T2V）、图像生成视频（I2V）和参考生成视频（R2V）任务中，Seedance 2.0 在所有评测维度上均获得最高分，展现出对当前竞品的全面领先性能。

paras.en: Marked improvements have been achieved in motion stability, instruction following capability, and visual aesthetics. The model effectively mitigates common structural inaccuracies and visual artifacts, generating smooth and nuanced complex motions. It can accurately render high-tension large-scale movements and subtle micro-expressions, while supporting professional-level combined camera movements and narrative rhythm control. For long scripts and open-ended instructions, the model can respond appropriately and deliver reasonable generation outputs. Meanwhile, the generated videos exhibit notable cinematic aesthetics, with well-rendered object textures, lighting and composition, as well as costume, makeup and prop design. In the audio domain, Seedance 2.0 maintains strong performance with substantial improvements in audio expressiveness. Its dual-channel audio output presents rich and nuanced layers, and can generate sound effects or melodies that align well with the context described in the prompts. Compared with the previous version, the model delivers an enhanced audio-visual integrated experience, with tighter alignment between dialogue lines, sound effects, background audio, and visual content. Meanwhile, the instruction following accuracy for Chinese dialects, traditional opera, and singing scenarios is significantly improved. (See https://www.doubao.com/chat/create-video and https://jimeng.jianying.com/ai-tool/video/generate.)
paras.zh: 在运动稳定性、指令跟随能力和视觉美学方面实现了显著改进。该模型有效缓解了常见的结构失真和视觉伪影，生成流畅而精细的复杂运动。它能准确渲染高张力的大幅度动作和细微的微表情，同时支持专业级的组合镜头运动和叙事节奏控制。对于长脚本和开放式指令，模型能够恰当响应并给出合理的生成结果。同时，生成的视频展现出显著的电影级美学，物体纹理、光照与构图以及服装、化妆和道具设计都得到了良好呈现。在音频方面，Seedance 2.0 保持了强劲性能，音频表现力大幅提升。其双声道音频输出呈现丰富而细腻的层次，能够生成与提示词所描述情境高度契合的音效或旋律。与上一版本相比，该模型提供了更强的视听一体化体验，台词、音效、背景音频与视觉内容的对齐更加紧密。同时，针对中文方言、传统戏曲和演唱场景的指令跟随准确率显著提高。（参见 https://www.doubao.com/chat/create-video 和 https://jimeng.jianying.com/ai-tool/video/generate。）

paras.en: Multi-modal Reference-Based Generation Evaluation. Seedance 2.0 achieves competitive leading comprehensive performance in reference-based generation tasks.
paras.zh: **多模态参考生成评估。**Seedance 2.0 在参考生成任务中取得了具有竞争力的领先综合表现。

paras.en: The model supports a more comprehensive range of reference-based tasks, covering multiple creative scenarios including multi-modal reference-based generation, video editing, and video continuation. Meanwhile, it demonstrates advantages in the depth of understanding and response accuracy for reference content. Specifically, in video editing tasks, Seedance 2.0 delivers more complete instruction following and more photorealistic visual outputs compared with peer models. In terms of generation consistency, the model achieves favorable performance in subject appearance and voice restoration, with particularly notable advantages in maintaining reference consistency for action logic, special effect styles, and plot narrative. Despite these strengths, there is still room for optimization in multi-subject consistency, text restoration accuracy, and the performance of complex editing tasks. We evaluate Seedance 2.0 on three generation tasks—T2V (Text-to-Video), I2V (Image-to-Video), and R2V (Reference-to-Video)—against current commercial video generation models. Seedance 2.0 ranks first across all video and audio dimensions on every task. On video, the main advances are: (1) Stability—fewer deformations and structural issues; complex actions are fluid; multilingual text generation and preservation are relatively strong. (2) Vividness—sports, combat, and other high-amplitude actions carry strong momentum; facial expressions and gaze are emotionally engaging; the model produces professional-level camera movements, dynamic editing, and narrative pacing. (3) Instruction following—long-script prompts are executed with reasonable precision, multi-shot and multi-angle instructions are followed accurately, and open-ended prompts receive appropriate creative interpretation; multiple art styles are supported; in I2V, special art styles from the reference image are preserved while adapting subject motion to match. (4) Visual realism—object materials look authentic, lighting, composition, and character texture improve notably, and costume and prop design is polished. On audio: (1) Expressiveness—audio is detailed and layered, with dual-channel support; melodies and tones match the prompt context, and the audio dimension adds to the emotional impact of the video. (2) Audio-visual sync—lip movements match the visual, dialogue, sound effects, and background audio align well, and beat-matching between audio and video is strong. (3) Audio instruction following—Chinese dialects (Sichuan, Northeastern, Cantonese), opera, and singing improve markedly over the previous version; singing, rap, and instrumental performance are consistent, with melodies adapted to the prompt context. Areas for improvement remain: minor deformation artifacts, motion plausibility in edge cases, high-frequency visual noise, audio distortion and noise, and lip-sync errors in multi-speaker scenes. The following subsections present detailed results for each task.
paras.zh: 该模型支持更全面的参考生成任务类型，涵盖多模态参考生成、视频编辑和视频续写等多种创作场景。同时，它在参考内容的理解深度和响应准确性方面展现出优势。具体而言，在视频编辑任务中，Seedance 2.0 相比同类模型实现了更完整的指令跟随和更逼真的视觉输出。在生成一致性方面，该模型在主体外观和语音恢复上取得了良好表现，尤其在动作逻辑、特效风格和剧情叙述的参考一致性保持上具有显著优势。尽管如此，在多主体一致性、文本恢复准确性以及复杂编辑任务的性能方面仍有优化空间。我们基于 T2V（文生视频）、I2V（图生视频）和 R2V（参考生成视频）三项生成任务，将 Seedance 2.0 与当前商业视频生成模型进行了对比。Seedance 2.0 在每项任务的所有视频和音频维度上均排名第一。在视频方面，主要进展包括：(1) **稳定性**——形变和结构问题更少，复杂动作流畅，多语言文本生成和保持相对较强。(2) **生动性**——运动、打斗等高幅度动作富有冲击力，面部表情和目光具有情感感染力；模型能产生专业级镜头运动、动态剪辑和叙事节奏。(3) **指令跟随**——长脚本提示词能以合理精度执行，多镜头、多角度指令被准确遵循，开放式提示词得到恰当的创造性诠释；支持多种艺术风格；在 I2V 中，在适配主体运动的同时保留参考图像的特定艺术风格。(4) **视觉真实感**——物体材质真实，光照、构图和角色纹理显著改善，服装与道具设计精良。在音频方面：(1) **表现力**——音频细节丰富、层次分明，支持双声道；旋律和音调与提示词情境匹配，音频维度增强了视频的情感冲击力。(2) **音画同步**——口型与画面匹配，台词、音效和背景音频对齐良好，音频与视频的节拍匹配性强。(3) **音频指令跟随**——中文方言（四川话、东北话、粤语）、戏曲和演唱较上一版本显著提升；演唱、说唱和器乐演奏保持一致，旋律根据提示词情境进行调整。仍存在改进空间：轻微形变伪影、边缘情况下的运动合理性、高频视觉噪声、音频失真与噪声，以及多说话人场景中的口型同步错误。以下各小节将给出每项任务的详细结果。

paras.en: To prepare the model for production deployment, we upgraded our evaluation framework to SeedVideoBench 2.0. The new version adds multi-modal generation, narrative quality, and multilingual coverage to the evaluation scope, and refines how audio expressiveness is assessed. We also brought in expert evaluators from advertising and game production to provide subjective ratings, with a focus on narrative and aesthetic quality.
paras.zh: 为了准备生产部署，我们将评估框架升级为 SeedVideoBench 2.0。新版本将多模态生成、叙事质量和多语言覆盖纳入评估范围，并改进了音频表现力的评估方式。我们还引入了来自广告和游戏制作领域的专家评估者，提供主观评分，重点关注叙事和美学质量。

paras.en: Two main changes define the new framework. First, a multimodal task evaluation system that formally defines multimodal task following and generation consistency, while also covering baseline generation quality (prompt following, motion quality) in multimodal settings. Second, we split evaluation into objective and subjective tracks. Objective metrics like motion stability use automated pipelines. Subjective metrics like aesthetics go through blind expert review. Separately, we ran a realism study: evaluators tried to tell Seedance 2.0 outputs apart from real video clips. The results fed back into our aesthetic tuning process. The multimodal task evaluation module and the narrative assessment module saw the largest changes from the previous version. Multimodal Task Following measures instruction-following accuracy across reference, editing,
paras.zh: 两个主要变化定义了新框架。第一，一个多模态任务评估系统，正式定义多模态任务遵循和生成一致性，同时覆盖多模态设置中的基线生成质量（提示遵循、运动质量）。第二，我们将评估分为客观和主观两条轨道。像运动稳定性这样的客观指标使用自动化流程；像美学这样的主观指标则经过专家盲审。另外，我们进行了一项真实感研究：评估者试图将 Seedance 2.0 的输出与真实视频片段区分开来。结果反馈到我们的美学调优过程中。与前版相比，多模态任务评估模块和叙事评估模块变化最大。多模态任务遵循衡量跨参考、编辑、

paras.en: and extension scenarios, broken into dozens of fine-grained task types (subject identity, motion, style, etc.). Most models have limited multimodal coverage, which forces users to probe capability boundaries through trial and error; these metrics make the boundaries explicit. Specifically, the evaluation covers four task groups: • Reference tasks: subject, motion, visual-effects, and style reference generation. • Editing tasks: subject, style, scene, and audio content editing. • Extension tasks: plot continuation and seamless extension, both forward and backward on the timeline. • Combination tasks: paired evaluations that match real workflows—e.g., swapping a video subject with a reference image (reference + editing combined). paras.en: how well non-edited regions survive during editing (editing consistency). We built specialized datasets covering subject, motion, scene, style, and audio, with sample distributions tuned to minimize variance at small evaluation budgets. On the video metrics side, SeedVideoBench 1.5 already tracked vividness; version 2.0 adds finer narrative quality metrics alongside the existing vividness and aesthetics dimensions. Unlike motion quality, which can be measured more objectively, narrative quality is inherently subjective—it asks whether the overall narrative reads as coherent, whether character performances and visual effects carry emotional weight, and whether the aesthetic choices fit the content. We evaluate it along three sub-dimensions: • Cinematographic language: does the camerawork support the story? We assess shot logic and expressiveness, looking for problems like redundant coverage, axis-crossing (180-degree rule violations), mismatched shot sizes, and uneven pacing. • Plot design: can the model take a vague or brief prompt and produce something both coherent and engaging? • Stylistic aesthetics: do the visuals have a considered look? This covers lighting, framing, composition, and color grading, plus whether characters, costumes, props, and sets hold together aesthetically. Unless otherwise noted, all evaluation results reported in the following sections are obtained using SeedVideoBench 2.0.
paras.zh: 非编辑区域在编辑过程中保持完好的程度（编辑一致性）。我们构建了涵盖主体、运动、场景、风格和音频的专业数据集，样本分布经过调整，以在较小的评估预算下最小化方差。在视频指标方面，SeedVideoBench 1.5 已经跟踪生动度；2.0 版本在现有生动度和美学维度之外，增加了更精细的叙事质量指标。与运动质量可以更客观地衡量不同，叙事质量本质上是主观的——它询问整体叙事是否连贯，角色表演和视觉效果是否承载情感重量，以及美学选择是否契合内容。我们沿三个子维度进行评估：• 电影语言：运镜是否支持故事？我们评估镜头逻辑和表现力，关注冗余覆盖、越轴（180度规则违反）、景别不匹配和节奏不均等问题。• 情节设计：模型能否从模糊或简短的提示中生成既连贯又吸引人的内容？• 风格美学：视觉是否有经设计的观感？这涵盖灯光、取景、构图和调色，以及角色、服装、道具和布景是否在美学上保持一致。除非另有说明，后续报告的所有评估结果均使用 SeedVideoBench 2.0 获得。

paras.en: Arena (formerly LMArena) [2], created by researchers from UC Berkeley, is a community-powered platform that evaluates AI models through real-world user preferences. For video generation, users are presented with outputs from two anonymous models side-by-side and vote for the one they prefer, producing an Elo-style leaderboard that reflects genuine human judgment at scale. Unlike automated benchmarks that rely on metrics such as FVD or CLIPScore, Arena captures holistic human preferences encompassing visual quality, motion realism, temporal coherence, and prompt adherence in a single unified ranking. As shown in Figure 2, our Dreamina Seedance 2.0 720p ranks #1 on both the Text-to-Video and Image-to-Video leaderboards, with Elo scores of 1450 (±15) and 1449 (±11) respectively. On T2V (Figure 2a), it leads the second-place veo-3.1-audio-1080p by 79 points; on I2V (Figure 2b), it leads grok-imagine-video-720p by 29 points. Notably, the model achieves this at 720p resolution, outperforming competitors that operate at 1080p, which suggests that our improvements in motion dynamics and visual coherence are more perceptually significant than resolution alone. The Rank Spread of 1↔1 on both leaderboards indicates consistently top-ranked performance across evaluation dimensions. These results complement our SeedVideoBench 2.0 findings, demonstrating that the gains observed in objective metrics translate directly into stronger human preference.
paras.zh: Arena（前身为 LMArena）[2]，由加州大学伯克利分校的研究人员创建，是一个通过真实用户偏好评估 AI 模型的社区驱动平台。对于视频生成，用户会并排看到两个匿名模型的输出，并投票选出他们更喜欢的一个，从而产生反映大规模真实人类判断的 Elo 风格排行榜。与依赖 FVD 或 CLIPScore 等指标的自动基准不同，Arena 在单一统一排名中捕捉整体人类偏好，涵盖视觉质量、运动真实感、时间连贯性和提示遵循。如图 2 所示，我们的 Dreamina Seedance 2.0 720p 在文生视频和图生视频排行榜上均排名第一，Elo 分数分别为 1450（±15）和 1449（±11）。在 T2V（图 2a）上，它领先第二名 veo-3.1-audio-1080p 79 分；在 I2V（图 2b）上，它领先 grok-imagine-video-720p 29 分。值得注意的是，该模型在 720p 分辨率下实现了这一成绩，超越了在 1080p 下运行的竞争对手，这表明我们在运动动态和视觉一致性方面的改进在感知上比单纯的分辨率更重要。两个排行榜上 1↔1 的排名跨度表示在所有评估维度上始终保持最高排名。这些结果补充了我们的 SeedVideoBench 2.0 发现，证明在客观指标上观察到的收益直接转化为更强的人类偏好。

paras.en: Seedance 2.0 leads on motion stability, editing rhythm, and multi-entity interaction, with far fewer cases of subject deformation and physically implausible motion than Seedance 1.5. Kling 3.0 ranks second but is limited on high-difficulty actions and complex camera work. Veo 3.1 and Sora 2 Pro handle basic motion reasonably well, yet fall short on fine-grained dynamics and long-take stability. The fine-grained breakdown in Table 3 confirms this: Seedance 2.0 ranks first on 29 of 30 categories (tying with Kling 3.0 only on group coordinated motion), scoring 3.29–4.43. Multi-entity feature match (4.43), framing/composition (4.25), and editing rhythm (4.21) all exceed 4.0. Seedance 1.5 scored low on physical feedback (1.69), natural phenomena (2.00), and intense sports motion (2.00); Seedance 2.0 improves by over 1.5 points on each. Kling 3.0 does well on emotion & expression (3.64), abstract challenges (3.57), and multi-entity feature match (3.43), but drops on intense sports motion (2.86), surreal motion (2.86), and special camera shots (3.08). Sora 2 Pro scores lowest on surreal motion (2.00) and intense sports motion (2.21); Veo 3.1 is weakest on multi-entity feature match (2.50) and group coordinated motion (2.33).
paras.zh: Seedance 2.0在运动稳定性、剪辑节奏和多实体交互方面领先，与Seedance 1.5相比，主体变形和物理上不合理的运动案例大大减少。Kling 3.0排名第二，但在高难度动作和复杂运镜方面存在局限。Veo 3.1和Sora 2 Pro对基本运动的处理尚可，但在细粒度动态和长镜头稳定性方面表现不足。表3的细粒度分解证实了这一点：Seedance 2.0在30个类别中的29个上排名第一（仅在群组协调运动上与Kling 3.0并列），得分区间为3.29–4.43。多实体特征匹配（4.43）、取景/构图（4.25）和剪辑节奏（4.21）均超过4.0。Seedance 1.5在物理反馈（1.69）、自然现象（2.00）和激烈体育运动（2.00）上得分较低；Seedance 2.0在每项上提升了超过1.5分。Kling 3.0在情感与表达（3.64）、抽象挑战（3.57）和多实体特征匹配（3.43）方面表现良好，但在激烈体育运动（2.86）、超现实运动（2.86）和特殊镜头（3.08）上得分下降。Sora 2 Pro在超现实运动（2.00）和激烈体育运动（2.21）上得分最低；Veo 3.1在多实体特征匹配（2.50）和群组协调运动（2.33）上最弱。

paras.en: Aesthetics is the most competitive dimension. Seedance 2.0 leads on visual effects, scene design, lighting and color, and realistic detail. Kling 3.0 is relatively strong on stylization and color expression, while other competitors are weaker on photorealism and fine detail. In Table 5, Seedance 2.0 ranks first or tied for first on 28 of 30 categories, scoring 2.79–4.14. Its highest scores are visual style (4.14), long script (4.14), framing/composition (4.13), and four categories at 4.00 (cinematic visual effects, editing rhythm, natural phenomena, multi-entity feature match). Seedance 2.0 does not lead on consumer visual effects (Seedance 1.5: 3.00 vs. 2.79) or surreal motion (Kling 3.0: 3.86 vs. 3.57), and ties on anthropomorphic motion (3.71, three-way) and advanced camera movement (3.54, tied with Kling 2.6). Kling 3.0 scores above 3.5 on 13 categories, with its best on surreal motion (3.86), same-type interaction (3.79), and framing/composition (3.75). Sora 2 Pro and Veo 3.1 lag: Sora 2 Pro drops below 2.5 on holidays (2.38), consumer visual effects (2.38), and natural phenomena (2.33); Veo 3.1 scores lowest on holidays (2.36), consumer visual effects (2.45), and multi-entity feature match (2.50). 10

paras.en: Kling 3.0 regresses from Kling 2.6 on singing/rap and ambient background sound. Sora 2 Pro produces vivid audio with strength on singing, though limited to a narrow set of categories. Competitors broadly have muddy audio, noticeable noise, and weak layering, especially on complex sound effects and vocal clarity. Per Table 6, Seedance 2.0 ranks first on all 17 categories, scoring 2.82–4.17. English (4.17), voice + action interaction (4.00), minority languages (3.82), and ambient/background sound (3.78) are strongest. The improvement over Seedance 1.5 is largest on Chinese opera (2.50 → 3.75), English (3.00 → 4.17), and singing/rap (2.71 → 3.71). Kling 3.0 drops below Kling 2.6 on singing/rap (2.71 vs. 3.14) and ambient/background sound (2.33 vs. 2.78), despite improving elsewhere. Sora 2 Pro scores 3.67 on singing/rap (second only to Seedance 2.0) and 3.17 on voice + action interaction, but falls to 2.17 on Chinese opera and 2.44 on ambient sound. No competitor exceeds 3.2 on any category apart from Sora 2 Pro's singing/rap (3.67).

paras.en: Lip synchronization and action-audio alignment are both strong for Seedance 2.0, with very few cases of delay or misalignment. Competitors commonly produce lip-speech mismatches and action-sound offsets, worse in fast dialogue and complex action scenes. In Table 7, Seedance 2.0 ranks first on 16 of 17 categories (tying with Seedance 1.5 on off-screen voice at 2.86), scoring 2.86–4.17. English (4.17), singing/rap (4.14), dual-channel audio (4.00), and non-verbal voice (4.00) are strongest. The largest gains over Seedance 1.5 are Chinese multi-person dialogue (2.36 → 3.86), object interaction sound (2.65 → 3.82), and animal sound (2.79 → 3.93). No competitor reaches 3.5 on any category apart from Sora 2 Pro on singing/rap (3.50) and Seedance 1.5 on English (3.50). Veo 3.1 is weakest, dropping to 1.67 on spatial scene and 2.10 on Chinese multi-person dialogue. Kling 3.0 regresses from Kling 2.6 on singing/rap (2.57 vs. 3.00) and instruments & audio (2.79 vs. 3.00), while improving on Chinese dialect (3.14 vs. 2.68).

paras.en: Audio prompt following is the dimension where competitors score lowest. Seedance 2.0 is strong on complex audio instructions involving multilingual dialogue, dialect-specific speech, and diverse sound profiles such as animal vocalizations. Sora 2 Pro has an edge on instrument and natural sound effect following, while other models are weaker at generating specific timbres and language-accurate audio. Table 8 shows Seedance 2.0 first on 16 of 17 categories (tying with Kling 3.0 on off-screen voice at 3.14), scoring 2.91–4.25. English (4.25), instruments & audio (3.89), ambient/background sound (3.89), voice + action interaction (3.86), and animal sound (3.86) are strongest. The largest gains over Seedance 1.5 are Chinese opera (1.75 → 3.50), singing/rap (2.14 → 3.71), and animal sound (2.50 → 3.86). Chinese dialect drops below 2.0 for five of six.
paras.zh: 音频提示跟随是竞争对手得分最低的维度。Seedance 2.0 在处理复杂音频指令方面表现出色，这些指令涉及多语言对话、特定方言语音以及诸如动物叫声等多样化的声音特征。Sora 2 Pro 在乐器与自然音效的跟随方面具有优势，而其他模型在生成特定音色和语言准确的音频方面较弱。表8显示，Seedance 2.0 在17个类别中的16个上排名第一（在画外音上与 Kling 3.0 并列，评分为3.14），得分区间为2.91–4.25。英语（4.25）、乐器与音频（3.89）、环境/背景音（3.89）、语音+动作交互（3.86）和动物声音（3.86）表现最强。相对于 Seedance 1.5 提升最大的是中国戏曲（1.75 → 3.50）、演唱/说唱（2.14 → 3.71）和动物声音（2.50 → 3.86）。汉语方言在六项中的五项评分低于2.0。

paras.en: usability vs. Kling 3.0’s 90.55%, though the satisfaction gap is wider (38.85% vs. 27.27%). The audio contrast is sharper. On audio quality, Seedance 2.0 reaches 97.42% usability and 57.08% satisfaction; Kling 2.6 and Wan 2.6 have usability below 28%, meaning most of their audio is rated unacceptable. On audio prompt following, Seedance 2.0’s 63.52% satisfaction is 1.7× Seedance 1.5 Pro’s 37.77% and over 10× Kling 2.6’s 5.70%. Beyond the scores, human evaluation of generated videos surfaces additional patterns. Seedance 2.0 produces dynamic motion with a clear sense of momentum—combat and dance sequences mix slow-motion highlights with fast action in ways competitors do not, and facial expressions and gaze are more vivid than Seedance 1.5 Pro. Camera work tracks subject motion closely with varied angles and smooth push/pull transitions. First- and third-person game-following perspectives with handheld breathing effects are new to this version and add immersion. The model handles special art styles (felt, oil painting, Chinese gongbi) without breaking visual coherence, matching subject motion to the referenced style. Realistic and 3D visual effects render fluidly. On the audio side, dialogue voices carry emotional nuance in both Chinese and non-Chinese languages. Voice, sound effects, and audio are well-layered—outputs sound like composed audio rather than isolated tracks stacked together. Common Chinese dialects (Sichuan, Northeastern, Cantonese) come through accurately. Singing, rap, and instrumental audio across languages are strong, with melodies that fit the prompt context. 2.4.2
paras.zh: 可用性相比 Kling 3.0 的 90.55% 有所提高，但满意度差距更大（38.85% 对 27.27%）。音频对比更为明显。在音频质量方面，Seedance 2.0 的可用性达到 97.42%，满意度为 57.08%；Kling 2.6 和 Wan 2.6 的可用性低于 28%，意味着它们的大部分音频被评为不可接受。在音频提示跟随方面，Seedance 2.0 的满意度为 63.52%，是 Seedance 1.5 Pro（37.77%）的 1.7 倍，是 Kling 2.6（5.70%）的 10 倍以上。除了分数之外，对生成视频的人工评估还揭示了其他模式。Seedance 2.0 生成的动态动作具有清晰的动感——战斗和舞蹈场景将慢动作高光与快动作相结合，这是竞争对手所没有的；面部表情和目光比 Seedance 1.5 Pro 更加生动。镜头运动紧密跟踪主体运动，角度多变，推拉转换平滑。第一人称和第三人称游戏跟随视角，配合手持呼吸效果，是该版本新增的功能，增强了沉浸感。该模型处理特殊艺术风格（毛毡、油画、中国工笔）时不会破坏视觉连贯性，使主体运动与参考风格相匹配。写实和 3D 视觉效果渲染流畅。在音频方面，对话声音在中文和非中文语言中都带有情感细微差别。人声、音效和音频层次分明——输出听起来像经过编排的音频，而不是简单堆叠的孤立音轨。常见的中国方言（四川话、东北话、粤语）都能准确呈现。跨语言的歌唱、说唱和器乐音频表现强劲，旋律与提示上下文契合。2.4.2

paras.en: Prompt Abstraction. This category tests UGC-style creative prompts and script-controlled generation. Seedance 2.0 leads on all three metrics for script-controlled (15s) generation and on MQ and IP for UGC creative/portrait (Table 11). The gap is largest on script-controlled (15s) generation: VPF 3.87 vs. Kling 3.0’s 3.00 and Wan 2.6’s 2.50. Veo 3.1 scores 3.87 on VPF for UGC creative/portrait—the best in that sub-category—but its MQ (2.53) and IP (2.87) are much lower. Kling 2.6 falls below 2.5 on MQ for both sub-categories, and Wan 2.6 drops to 2.14 on script-controlled MQ. Open-ended and script-based prompts remain difficult for most models; only Seedance 2.0 and Kling 3.0 consistently exceed 3.0 on MQ. paras.en: Seedance 2.0 leads all evaluated models on R2V, outperforming Kling 3 Omni [12], Kling O1 [11], and Vidu Q2 Pro [18] across every dimension. It supports more multi-modal task types with higher accuracy. Beyond the subject, style, motion reference, and video editing supported by competitors, Seedance 2.0 also handles creative and visual-effects reference, video continuation and extension, and combined tasks such as motion reference + subject reference, with fewer cases of missing or confused input materials. Reference alignment is best across subject appearance, voice, motion, and style, with clear advantages in subject identity and style preservation. Motion quality—vividness, physical plausibility, and structural stability—is uniformly stronger, with stability as the largest lead. Prompt following is also strongest, particularly on long-text and complex narratives, visual effects, dialogue, text rendering, and open-ended instructions. Table 24 quantifies this: Seedance 2.0 ranks first on all five dimensions, scoring 2.50 and 2.52 on multimodal task following and prompt following (1–3 scale), and 3.54, 3.03, 3.24 on editing consistency, reference alignment, and motion quality (1–5 scale). The gaps are smallest on editing consistency (Kling 3.0 trails by 0.17) and largest on motion quality (0.86–0.94 behind across all competitors) and reference alignment (0.66–1.24 behind). Vidu Q2 Pro scores lowest on three of five dimensions. Kling 3.0 and Kling O1 trade second and third depending on the dimension, but neither approaches Seedance 2.0 on motion quality or prompt following. Table 25: R2V multi-modal task support across models. ✓ = supported, ✗ = not supported. Seedance 2.0
paras.zh: Seedance 2.0 在 R2V 上领先所有受评估模型，在每个维度上都优于 Kling 3 Omni [12]、Kling O1 [11] 和 Vidu Q2 Pro [18]。它支持更多类型的多模态任务，且准确性更高。除了竞争对手支持的主体、风格、运动参考和视频编辑之外，Seedance 2.0 还处理创意和视觉效果参考、视频续写与扩展，以及运动参考+主体参考等组合任务，且输入材料缺失或混淆的问题更少。参考对齐在主体外观、声音、运动和风格方面均表现最佳，在主体身份和风格保持方面具有明显优势。运动质量——生动性、物理合理性和结构稳定性——全面更强，其中稳定性领先最大。提示跟随也最强，尤其是在长文本和复杂叙事、视觉效果、对话、文本渲染和开放式指令方面。表 24 量化了这一点：Seedance 2.0 在所有五个维度上均排名第一，多模态任务跟随和提示跟随得分为 2.50 和 2.52（1–3 分制），编辑一致性、参考对齐和运动质量得分为 3.54、3.03 和 3.24（1–5 分制）。差距最小的是编辑一致性（Kling 3.0 落后 0.17），最大的是运动质量（所有竞争对手落后 0.86–0.94）和参考对齐（落后 0.66–1.24）。Vidu Q2 Pro 在五个维度中的三个得分最低。Kling 3.0 和 Kling O1 根据维度不同分别占据第二和第三名，但两者在运动质量或提示跟随上都无法接近 Seedance 2.0。表 25：各模型的 R2V 多模态任务支持。✓ = 支持，✗ = 不支持。Seedance 2.0

paras.en: Seedance 2.0 produces the best reference alignment for body motion, visual effects, and creative sequences, while competitors frequently fail to reproduce referenced effects or capture complete body movements. Table 27 shows Seedance 2.0 scoring 2.60 on motion reference task following, ahead of Kling 3 Omni (2.20), Kling O1 (2.19), and Vidu Q2 Pro (1.92). On reference alignment, the gap widens: Seedance 2.0 scores 2.64, while all competitors fall below 2.0—Vidu Q2 Pro scores only 1.14, meaning most outputs bear little resemblance to the reference motion. One exception: on first-frame preservation, Kling 3 Omni scores 4.31, well above Seedance 2.0’s 2.71. Kling 3 Omni tends to keep the first frame nearly unchanged but produces weaker subsequent motion, while Seedance 2.0 generates more dynamic video at the cost of lower first-frame fidelity. On style reference, Seedance 2.0 leads with 2.57 on task following (60% 3-point rate) vs. Vidu Q2 Pro (2.15, 33.33%) and Kling O1 (1.96, 10.71%). Kling 3 Omni does not support style reference at all. Reference alignment follows the same order: 2.37, 1.85, 1.84. When combining style and subject reference, Seedance 2.0 produces more accurate responses and better generation quality; competitors frequently misinterpret the task as reference-image editing or produce artifacts, with Kling 3 Omni exhibiting this issue most often. Video editing is the most competitive R2V task. In Table 28, Kling O1 slightly leads on task following (2.29 vs. Seedance 2.0’s 2.20), and Kling 3 Omni is close at 2.24—all three within 0.09 points. However, Seedance 2.0 pulls ahead on reference alignment (3.79 vs. Kling O1’s 3.03) and editing consistency (3.75 vs. Kling 3 Omni’s 3.09). Seedance 2.0 responds better to long-text and multi-edit instructions and handles complex editing tasks more completely, while also producing more accurate results for well-known IP references. All models share common failure modes: unresponsive edits and unintended modifications to non-edit regions. Video continuation is currently supported only by Seedance 2.0, which scores 2.88 on task following and 3.18 on reference alignment. It handles complex narratives and long-text continuation prompts well, though issues remain with color consistency, multi-subject omission, and subject duplication. For video extension, Seedance 2.0 and Veo 3.1 are the only two models evaluated, but they differ in scope: 21
paras.zh: Seedance 2.0 在身体运动、视觉效果和创意序列方面取得了最佳的参照对齐效果，而竞品模型经常无法复现所参照的效果或捕捉完整的身体动作。表 27 显示 Seedance 2.0 在运动参照任务跟随上得分 2.60，领先于 Kling 3 Omni（2.20）、Kling O1（2.19）和 Vidu Q2 Pro（1.92）。在参照对齐上，差距进一步拉大：Seedance 2.0 得分 2.64，而所有竞品均低于 2.0——Vidu Q2 Pro 仅得 1.14，意味着大多数输出与参照运动几乎没有相似性。一个例外是首帧保持：Kling 3 Omni 得分 4.31，远超 Seedance 2.0 的 2.71。Kling 3 Omni 倾向于几乎不改动首帧，但后续运动较弱；而 Seedance 2.0 生成的视频更具动态性，代价是首帧保真度较低。在风格参照上，Seedance 2.0 在任务跟随上以 2.57 领先（3 分率为 60%），Vidu Q2 Pro 为 2.15（33.33%），Kling O1 为 1.96（10.71%）。Kling 3 Omni 完全不支持风格参照。参照对齐顺序也相同：2.37、1.85、1.84。当结合风格与主体参照时，Seedance 2.0 的反应更准确、生成质量更好；竞品经常将任务误解为参照图像编辑或产生伪影，其中 Kling 3 Omni 出现该问题最为频繁。视频编辑是竞争最激烈的 R2V 任务。在表 28 中，Kling O1 在任务跟随上略微领先（2.29 对 Seedance 2.0 的 2.20），Kling 3 Omni 接近为 2.24——三者相差均在 0.09 分以内。然而，Seedance 2.0 在参照对齐（3.79 对 Kling O1 的 3.03）和编辑一致性（3.75 对 Kling 3 Omni 的 3.09）上领先。Seedance 2.0 对长文本和多编辑指令的响应更好，能更完整地处理复杂编辑任务，同时对于知名 IP 参照也能产生更准确的结果。所有模型都有共同的失败模式：编辑无响应以及对非编辑区域的非预期修改。视频续写目前仅 Seedance 2.0 支持，其在任务跟随上得分 2.88，参照对齐上得分 3.18。它能很好地处理复杂叙事和长文本续写提示，但在色彩一致性、多主体遗漏和主体重复方面仍有问题。对于视频扩展，只有 Seedance 2.0 和 Veo 3.1 两个模型参与评估，但它们的范围不同：21

paras.en: Seedance 2.0 accepts arbitrary uploaded videos for extension and supports combining extension with subject image input, while Veo 3.1 can only extend videos it generated itself. Despite broader input support, Seedance 2.0’s extension quality trails Veo 3.1 notably—Veo 3.1 scores 2.78 on task following (88.89% 3-point rate) vs. Seedance 2.0’s 1.93 (31.82%), and 3.44 vs. 3.28 on reference alignment, making extension Seedance 2.0’s weakest R2V task.

paras.en: Leveraging significant advancements in foundational capabilities and Multimodal Task Performance, Seedance 2.0 will deliver an entirely new creative experience for users. It is capable of synthesizing temporally precise and complex interactive scenes with high fidelity. As shown in the first and second row of Figure 4, the generation process maintains exceptional motion quality by strictly adhering to real-world physical laws of motion, avoiding physical anomalies commonly observed in earlier AI-generated videos. For example, in the skating scenario, the model effectively renders a series of highly demanding maneuvers—such as synchronized take-offs, mid-air rotations, and precise landings. In response to the diversified demands of video content production, Seedance 2.0 demonstrates exceptional scenario adaptability in the third row of Figure 4. Whether applied to commercial advertising, television visual effects, video game animation, or explainer videos, the model consistently delivers high-quality generation results and robust multimodal task performance. By replacing complex visual effects pipelines and live-action workflows with AI-driven generation, Seedance 2.0 significantly reduces the production costs of professional audio and video content, shortens production cycles, and empowers both creators and enterprises to more effectively realize their creative visions.
paras.zh: 借助基础能力和多模态任务性能的重大进步，Seedance 2.0 将为用户带来全新的创意体验。它能够以高保真度合成时间精确且复杂的交互场景。如图 4 的第一行和第二行所示，生成过程严格遵循真实世界的物理运动规律，保持了卓越的运动质量，避免了早期 AI 生成视频中常见的物理异常。例如，在滑冰场景中，模型能够有效渲染一系列高难度动作——如同步起跳、空中旋转和精准落地。为应对视频内容制作的多样化需求，Seedance 2.0 在图 4 的第三行展示了出色的场景适应性。无论是应用于商业广告、电视视觉效果、视频游戏动画，还是解释性视频，该模型都能持续提供高质量的生成结果和强大的多模态任务性能。通过用 AI 驱动的生成替代复杂的视觉特效流程和真人拍摄工作流，Seedance 2.0 显著降低了专业音视频内容的生产成本，缩短了制作周期，并赋能创作者和企业更有效地实现其创意愿景。

paras.en: Competitive-level pair figure skating scene. The opening low-angle shot follows the skate blades, with ice shavings and reflective details clearly visible. Entering the spin segment, the male skater's axis slightly deviates, causing a misstep, and the spin rhythm briefly collapses. The female skater quickly adjusts her center of gravity, with a calm gaze and signals "Stay with me," actively guiding the male skater to realign the rhythm. Subsequently, they seamlessly transition into a lift, with clean and stable lines. The climax is a synchronized jump combination, with upright air positions and decisive landings, perfectly synchronized audio and visual. The female skater wears a dark blue figure skating dress, while the male skater wears competitive sportswear. The overall presentation depicts a complete narrative from tense mistakes to calmly finishing the competition, reflecting the technical ability and psychological strength in top-level pair figure skating.
paras.zh: 竞技级双人花样滑冰现场。开场低机位跟随冰刀滑行，冰屑与反光细节清晰。进入旋转段，男选手轴线微偏出现失误，旋转节奏短暂塌陷。女选手迅速调整重心，眼神冷静并示意“Stay with me”，主动引导男选手重新对齐节奏。随后无缝衔接托举动作，线条干净稳定。高潮为同步跳跃组合，空中姿态笔直，落冰果断，音画完美对齐。女选手身着深蓝花滑裙，男选手为竞技运动装。整体呈现从紧张失误到冷静完成比赛的完整叙事，体现顶级双人花样滑冰中的技术能力与心理强度。

paras.en: Wuxia-style audio-visual blockbuster: in a bamboo forest, a white-clad swordsman and a raincoat-clad blade warrior face off. The camera slowly tracks between the two, shifting focus between raindrops and the sword hilt, with the tension at its peak; only the sound of rain can be heard. Suddenly a thunderclap flashes, and the two charge simultaneously. The side-on camera pans at extreme speed, capturing the splashing mud under their feet. At the instant their weapons clash, the shot cuts to extreme slow motion, clearly showing a circular shockwave as the sword and blade scatter the rain, as well as bamboo leaves severed by the sword energy. Then it returns to normal speed: the two land back-to-back, the blade warrior's bamboo hat splits open, and the image abruptly ends.
paras.zh: 武侠风格视听大片，竹林里白衣剑客与蓑衣刀客对峙。镜头在两人之间缓慢推移，焦点在雨滴和剑柄之间切换，气氛压抑到极点，只能听见雨声。突然一道惊雷闪过，两人同时冲锋，侧拍镜头极速平移，捕捉泥浆飞溅的脚步。双兵相接瞬间画面切换为极慢动作，清晰展示刀剑震飞雨水形成的圆环激波，以及被剑气切断的竹叶。随后恢复常速，两人背对背落地，蓑衣刀客的斗笠裂开，画面戛然而止。

paras.en: The figure in the painting looks guilty — eyes darting left and right, then peeks out beyond the picture frame. Quickly reaches a hand out of the frame, picks up a cola, takes a sip, and breaks into a deeply satisfied expression. Just then, the sound of footsteps approaches. The figure hurriedly puts the cola back in its place. At that moment, a Western cowboy walks up, picks up the cola from the glass, and walks away with it. The closing shot pushes in to a top-lit close-up of the cola against a pure black background. At the bottom of the frame, stylized artistic subtitles appear alongside a voiceover: "宜口可乐，不可不尝！"
paras.zh: 画中的人物看起来心虚——眼睛左右游移，然后探出画框向外张望。它迅速伸手到画框外，拿起一瓶可乐，喝了一口，露出极其满足的表情。就在此时，脚步声靠近。人物急忙把可乐放回原处。这时，一位西部牛仔走过来，从玻璃上拿起可乐，然后带着它走开了。结尾镜头推近，以顶光特写拍摄，可乐衬在纯黑背景上。画面底部，风格化的艺术字幕伴随画外音出现：“宜口可乐，不可不尝！”
